replacements.newText:
- name: Check out pinned R source for a missing selected seed cache
        if: ${{ steps.seed-selection.outputs.full-qualification == 'true' && steps.selected-cache-check.outputs.qualified-valid != 'true' }}
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ steps.seed-selection.outputs.source-ref }}
          path: native-authoring-source
      - name: Recover all four selected R products with native Lean and TypeScript 7
        if: ${{ steps.seed-selection.outputs.full-qualification == 'true' && steps.selected-cache-check.outputs.qualified-valid != 'true' }}
        env:
          PSC0_NATIVE_SEED_CACHE: ${{ github.workspace }}/psc0/${{ steps.seed-selection.outputs.cache-directory }}
        run: |
          node scripts/sh1-native-seed-recovery.mjs \
            --source-workspace "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/native-authoring-source/psc0" \
            --out "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/psc0/dist/sh1-native-seed-recovery" \
            --cache-directory "$PSC0_NATIVE_SEED_CACHE"
